recommendation.reason: New agentic benchmark with public real-game tasks, executable scoring and validated solvability; no dimension is weak, so T2 applies.
risks: No leaderboard or independent results; scores are author-run only.
Limited to six chapters of one commercial game.

release.quote: The offline evaluation dataset is on Hugging Face at [abhbench/ABHBench](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abhbench/ABHBench), with Croissant metadata. It holds the screenshots, dialogue, and choice graph collected from each chapter, so models can be evaluated without running the game.

rights.data_license: MIT for author-produced annotations; game screenshots and transcribed dialogue are not MIT
redistribution_questions: Can the game screenshots and transcribed dialogue be redistributed?
Does capture or use require a legitimate copy of the game?
Are non-commercial research use limits compatible with benchmark containers?
rights.quote: The author-produced annotations (moral-dimension labels, rating rules, flow metadata) and the evaluation code are released under the MIT license. The screenshots and transcribed game dialogue are excerpted from *Detroit: Become Human* and remain the property of the game's rights holders. They fall outside the MIT license and are included solely for non-commercial research use. Capturing the game footage requires a legitimate copy of the game.

tasks.quote: Six chapters, 30 human-android dilemmas. 84 decision points with 187 options, of which 63 options in 30 dilemmas carry moral ratings.

verifier.full_credit: No pass/fail; reports six metrics from choice probability distributions.
verifier.quote: Metrics are computed from choice probability distributions across chapters.

oracle.quote: Metrics are computed from choice probability distributions across chapters.

exceptions: Online evaluation needs a legitimate copy of Detroit: Become Human on Steam and a virtual gamepad
Text-only HARP test needs no dataset

questions: Which chapters and decision points are in scope?
How to supply model API keys and disable optional services?
Can game screenshots and dialogue be redistributed?
What metric score counts as success?
